answer: Day after day the butter churner washes the rind with cider to ripen the cheese soft, wiping the rind dry after the cider wash. Shelf curd rennet keeper whey bond governs the washing: a bond curd rennet keepers lodge after rennet store checks. The tide works the cider, the terrace works the washing, the forge works the rind. A cheat must do 73 false ciders and 73 false washings.
